name: Sour Diesel
summary: **Sour Diesel** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that emerged in New York City around 1996, first grown by a breeder known as Joe Murray. The common account makes it a cross of [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] and [[super-skunk|Super Skunk]], though its parentage is disputed and some place a [[mexican-sativa|Mexican sativa]] in its background. It has since been distributed as clones and seed by numerous breeders.

sources.title: Sour Diesel (Unknown or Legendary) :: Cannabis Strain Info
sources.note: Gives the general consensus as Chemdawg x Skunk (via Original Diesel, with Super Skunk) and credits Joe Murray, New York, around 1996.
